correctness.rationale: In any group G, quandle operation x▷y=y^-1 x y; any G-prime orbit congruence respects both arguments since G/G-prime is abelian, and the quotient is medial because the two four-variable conjugators have equal abelianized products. Conversely the medial law with the identity substituted forces x^(yz)~x^(zy), and invariance under conjugation and congruence closure forces x~x^h for all h in G-prime. This establishes universal medialization as derived-subgroup conjugacy orbit set rather than group abelianization. For finite groups Burnside yields |G-prime|^-1 sum_{h in G-prime}|C_G(h)|. For n>=3, S_n-prime=A_n and precisely symmetric cycle classes of distinct odd lengths split into two A_n-orbits. Odd unsplit classes act by the common involution swapping each split pair; the remaining points act trivially. Hence p(n)+q(n) points, complete operation, Aut=(C2 wr S_{q(n)})×S_{o(n)}×S_{e(n)}; n=1,2 separately. For D_2m, G-prime=<r^2>; rotation singleton orbits and reflection index modulo gcd(m,4) give m+g points and the four explicit operations. An independent small-group direct conjugation-orbit construction checked S3 (4 points), S4 (6 points), S5 (8 points), well-definedness and medial identity. These finite checks supplement the all-group proof.
